independentCalculation:
Independent numpy annual-profile reconstruction and pvlib DC integration.

This verifies execution of a DECLARED synthetic policy, not climate accuracy.
NASA/JPL Space Place 'What Causes the Seasons?' (updated 2025-07-29) supports
opposite seasonal timing, NOT the day-200 peak, amplitude, equator policy or
mount offsets. Those remain explicitly local screening assumptions.
NOCT Eq1: DOI10.3390/app10030914. PVWatts DC: pvlib0.13.1.
No TypeScript imports, production outputs or network access.

expected.weatherProfileSource: Synthetic clear-sky-shaped 8760 profile normalized to annual PSH; no hourly provider weather was supplied
expected.methodologyNote: Temperature-weighted hourly Pmp correction using the module temperature coefficient and NOCT. Ambient seasonal/diurnal profiles are synthetic: the northern day-200 annual cosine is reversed in the south and absent at the equator. Zero irradiation reports a neutral zero-loss budget, not an evaluated thermal yield. The ±temperature band is a sensitivity to an explicit ±5°C bias (or configured amount), not a probability interval or bound on total forecast error.
